query:
SELECT 
  MIN(saleDate) as data_minima, 
  MAX(saleDate) as data_maxima,
  COUNT(*) as total_vendas,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN paymentMethod = 'Migração de Dados' THEN 1 END) as vendas_migradas
FROM sales
